name: Danish waters
source: OpenStreetMap land polygons via geo-maps earth-lands-100m 0.6.0 (npm @geo-maps/earth-lands-100m, about 100 m accuracy). Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, openstreetmap.org/copyright. Package code MIT.
licence: ODbL 1.0 (derived database: this region's raster, land and graph are ODbL too)
label_source: Label positions from GeoNames town coordinates (lutangar/cities.json, CC BY 4.0, geonames.org); label texts: tools/navigation/danish_labels.json.
crs: WGS 84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); raster in Mercator rows like the base chart
processing: Clipped to the region with a 0.1 deg margin; holes filled (lakes and tile-seam artefacts are land); raster at 360 cells per Mercator degree (6 x the base), land if any part of a cell is land (1/4 cell precision), approach water with a water majority; display simplified 0.0003 deg (detail) and 0.0035 deg (overview). Not for navigation.
